promises.promise: How agents talk to people in other apps. A connection is one bot signed in to one Discord server or Slack workspace, speaking for one agent.
Connects a bot to a server or workspace for one agent.
Decides which agent answers in a channel when nobody is addressed.
Links an outside user to the household member they are.
Records whether each reply arrived, and says so when it cannot tell.
The bot's token is a stored secret.
A person link says which household member an outside user is.
The message goes into one conversation: the agent in that channel.
It arrives in the inbox with discord or slack as its source.
An agent's run settings give each outside person a tier.
A message from outside is kept as an incoming message, matched to a person and a channel rule, and passed into the right conversation. It can be held or dropped, with a reason.
The agent's reply goes out as a send. Loom records whether it arrived. Uncertain means loom could not confirm it, and a person reviews it. A held send waits for a person to release or dismiss it.
A channel rule names the agent that answers in a channel. A connection can listen only to some channels, or ignore some.
A connection is one bot signed in to one Discord server or Slack workspace, speaking for one agent. Attachments fetched from Slack are kept for 14 days.
a Household things. Connections, channel rules and person links belong to the household. Household owners manage them and see them all.
b An agent's owners. An agent's owners see their agent's connections.
c Messages. An incoming message follows the labels of the conversation it goes into. A household owner sees everything, including what is private to another member.
d Checked at the door. Loom applies this to callers from outside: a person, an agent, a machine, someone's own program. Loom's own parts read without asking.
The Bridges tile has connections, channel rules, person links and pending sends.
The owner can save a Discord channel rule and a Slack person link in Bridges and inspect both after reload.
